description: This file contains unit tests for the NormalizedMessageMapper class within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing the conversion of various Ditto events and signals into normalized JSON messages, including configuration options and filtering behavior.

classes.name: NormalizedMessageMapperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for NormalizedMessageMapper, testing various event-to-message mappings, configuration options, and filtering logic within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of NormalizedMessageMapper.

methods.name: thingCreated
methods.description: Tests mapping of a ThingCreated event into a normalized JSON message.

methods.name: featurePropertyModified
methods.description: Tests mapping of a FeaturePropertyModified event into a normalized JSON message.

methods.name: headersFromAdaptableAreNotMapped
methods.description: Ensures headers from Adaptable objects aren't included in the mapped output.

methods.name: withFieldSelection
methods.description: Validates field filtering during mapping based on specified selection in configuration.

methods.name: withFullThingPayloadFieldSelection
methods.description: Tests mapping with full payload field selection, including comprehensive fields like thingId, policyId, attributes, etc.

methods.name: withExtraFieldsBeingIncluded
methods.description: Tests inclusion of extra fields and custom field selectors when mapping.

methods.name: deletedEventsAreNotMapped
methods.description: Verifies that delete events are not mapped into output messages.

methods.name: nonThingEventsAreNotMapped
methods.description: Checks that non-thing events and commands are ignored during mapping.

methods.name: assertNotMapped
methods.description: Helper method asserting that a given signal produces no mapping output.

methods.name: mapToJson
methods.description: Utility method to extract the JSON payload from the first mapped message.
